text.p: Alliance Gaming Corp Thursday said it settled its litigation with WMS Industries Inc for $4.5 million.
In a statement, the lawsuit arose out of a dispute concerning a break-up fee due under a canceled merger agreement between Bally Gaming International Inc and WMS.
WMS had obtained a judgment of $5.4 million against the company and was also seeking recovery of attorney fees and costs.
The company said the settlement will be treated as additional purchase price for the acquisition of Bally Gaming International Inc.
Separately, Alliance said Bally Gaming Inc has entered into an agreement with Congress Financial Corp for a new three-year line of credit to replace its existing line.

The new credit line doubles Bally Gaming's borrowing capacity to $30 million and lowers the interest rate to prime plus one percent. Currently, there are no outstanding borrowings under the new credit line.
Borrowings under the line of credit are subject to the overall $40 million limitation on worldwide line of credit borrowings provided in the indenture for Alliance Gaming's Senior Secured Notes.
